lines.en: label springtimesadness1:
scene postnikiinsta1
There are a lot of people who talk down on romantic comedies for their often unrealistic and over-exaggerated depictions of love.
lines.zh: 有很多人贬低浪漫喜剧，说它们对爱情的描写往往不切实际、过分夸张。

lines.en: But I’ve found, more often than not, that the people who typically do this have little to no experience with love at all.
lines.zh: 可我发现，说这种话的人，大多对爱情几乎一无所知，甚至根本毫无经验。

lines.en: Because love {i}is{/i} over-exaggerated. It {i}is{/i} unrealistic. And there are always going to be aspects of it that elude human rationale in order to exist in the form it {i}has{/i} to if we’re going to write about it.
lines.zh: 因为爱情本就{i}是{/i}夸张的。它本就不切实际。而它总要有某些超越人类理性的面向，才能以我们{i}必须{/i}书写出来的那种形态存在。

lines.en: Again, someone will say I’m wrong. Or that they could do it better. Or that {i}I’m{/i} the one who doesn’t understand because I’m stuck at some desk right now instead of experiencing my own romantic comedy.
lines.zh: 又会有人说{i}我{/i}错了。或者他们能写得更好。或者不懂的人是我——因为我现在正困在某张办公桌前，而没有去经历属于我自己的浪漫喜剧。

lines.en: But is there really a problem with that? For if I were to be getting swept up in the same hyperbolic fairy tales my peers have become so accustomed to emulating, you’d have no one left to talk to right now.
lines.zh: 可那真的有什么问题吗？因为倘若我正被同辈们早已习惯效仿的那些夸张童话所裹挟，那么此刻你就没有人可以说话了。

lines.en: And no one to guide you through the impending montage of consequences that have only just begun to make their presence known.
lines.zh: 也没有人能引领你走过即将到来的那一段后果的蒙太奇——它们才刚刚开始显露踪迹。

lines.en: I am safer here, observing. And it won’t be until someone waits outside of my window with a boombox over their head that I will so much as second guess that.
lines.zh: 我待在这里观察更安全。除非有人把手提音响举在头顶、守在我的窗外，否则我绝不会对此有半点动摇。

lines.en: Just I’m the type of person those things do not happen for. And I think, more often than not, that I will need to procure a boombox of my own if I want any chance at such a thing.
lines.zh: 只是我这种人，本来就不会碰上那种事。而且我想，多半我得自己弄一台手提音响，才有机会遇上这样的事。

lines.en: So I’ll leave you with this — there are few things more logical than the defiance of logic. It is perhaps the single most constant constant that has ever been or will be.
lines.zh: 所以我想留给你这句话——没有什么比违背逻辑更合乎逻辑。它大概是古往今来唯一恒久不变的常量。

lines.en: And if either of us are ever going to make it in this world, where it feels so often that everything is upside down, we will need to learn to cope with that. To break outside of this box.
lines.zh: 而如果我们两个人想在这个一切似乎都上下颠倒的世界里活下去，我们就必须学会与之共处。打破这个盒子。

lines.en: Because what we’ll see on the outside isn’t so much monochromatic as it is a vivid explosion of color. And it isn’t until those colors shower us like squalls that we’ll regret not bringing an umbrella.
lines.zh: 因为我们在外面看到的，与其说是单色的，不如说是一场绚烂的色彩爆炸。而直到那些色彩像骤雨一般浇在我们身上，我们才会后悔没有带伞。

lines.en: Perhaps in that moment, where the two of us are drenched in rain as the sun sets off in the distance, we will grow to appreciate what we haven’t thus far.
lines.zh: 也许就在那一刻，当我们两个被雨水浇透、而太阳正从远方落下时，我们才会开始珍惜那些我们至今未曾珍惜的东西。

lines.en: O, how colorful this life can be when the white is pulled from your eyes.
lines.zh: 啊，当白色从你眼前被抽走，这人生可以有多么缤纷。

lines.en: O, how pitiful it is to merely imagine it.
lines.zh: 啊，只能凭空想象它，又是何等可悲。

lines.en: : How farest thou on the opposite end of the room, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 房间另一头的 Otoha，你可还安好？

lines.en: : A rare case of writer’s block seems to have claimed my mind for the time being. And, for once, I feel as if I have nothing worth saying that hasn’t already been said.
lines.zh: : 罕见的文思枯竭似乎暂时占住了我的头脑。而且，有生以来第一次，我觉得自己想不出任何值得说、又还没被人说过的东西。

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta2
: Otoha?
lines.zh: : Otoha？

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta3
: Is this one of those times where I’m meant to leave you alone? Speak now or I may make my way over there just to feel the sting of your hand upon my cheek.
lines.zh: : 又到了那种我该让你一个人待着的时候了吗？现在开口，否则我可能就要走过去，只为感受你那巴掌落在我脸颊上的刺痛。

lines.en: : To be honest, I don’t really feel like writing either anymore.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我也已经不太想写了。

lines.en: : Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Not really, but...
lines.zh: : 不太好吧，可是……

lines.en: : What can you do?
lines.zh: : 又能怎么办呢？

lines.en: scene black
: Would it make you feel better to go raid the convenience store for an assortment of unhealthy items that we will surely regret consuming later?
lines.zh: : 要不要去便利店扫荡一堆不健康的东西，好让你心情好一点？我们之后肯定会后悔把它们吃掉的。

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, it would.
lines.zh: : 事实上，确实会。

lines.en: : And would you like to air out your woes to me along the way so I can pretend to understand them?
lines.zh: : 那你愿意在路上向我倾诉你的烦恼，好让我装作能理解的样子吗？

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, I wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 事实上，不愿意。

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta4
: Wow. I knew she liked the guy, but I can’t say I expected your sister to commit career suicide just because he showed up and played some song to her.
lines.zh: : 哇。我知道她喜欢那家伙，可我真没想到你姐姐会因为他出现、给她弹了首歌，就自毁前程。

lines.en: : I knew he’d win her back because Nee-chan’s self-esteem is only there for show, but...I also didn’t think she’d take it this far.
lines.zh: : 我就知道他会把她赢回去，因为姐姐的自尊心只是摆着好看的，可是……我也没想到她会做到这一步。

lines.en: : I guess it’s hard to ever really judge just {i}how{/i} serious someone is. Either that or she’s just trying to one-up Onii-chan’s grand gesture with her own.
lines.zh: : 我想，一个人到底有{i}多{/i}认真，本来就很难判断。要么就是她想用自己更盛大的举动，压过哥哥那场盛大的告白。

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta5
: Won’t this make things harder for {i}both{/i} of them, though? Like, Niki’s one thing, but now {i}Sensei’s{/i} going to be swarmed by paparazzi and angry fans too. His life is about to become Hell.
lines.zh: : 可这样不是会让{i}她俩{/i}都更难办吗？Niki 是一回事，可现在 {i}Sensei{/i} 也要被狗仔和愤怒的粉丝围追堵截了。他的人生就要变成地狱了。

lines.en: : I’d say that’s a pretty reasonable punishment for having sex with her little sister, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我觉得，对于和她妹妹上床这件事来说，这算是相当合理的惩罚了，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} okay?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}还好吗？

lines.en: : I think your feelings are a little more important than mine at the moment. {i}My{/i} sister’s still in denial about wanting to have sex with the guy I like.
lines.zh: : 我觉得眼下你的感受比{i}我的{/i}更重要一些。我姐姐还在否认自己想和那个我喜欢的人上床。

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta6
: You know...weirdly enough, I’m kind of {i}fine.{/i} But I guess I always knew things would end up like this, so that does soften the blow a little.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……说来奇怪，我还挺{i}平静{/i}的。不过我想我早就知道事情会变成这样，所以打击也就轻了一点。

lines.en: : And I’m sure it’s not going to make you reevaluate your approach to ultimately dating Sensei, is it?
lines.zh: : 而且我猜，这也不会让你重新审视自己最终追到 Sensei 的策略，对吧？

lines.en: : Nope. Nee-chan just declared war to millions of her followers. And she’s going to get one.
lines.zh: : 不会。姐姐刚刚向她几百万粉丝宣战了。而她会得到一场战争。

lines.en: : I’d ask if you want to form a truce, but I think we both know I’d stab you in the back the first chance I get.
lines.zh: : 我本来想问你要不要结个同盟，不过我想我们俩都心知肚明，一有机会我就会在背后捅你一刀。

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta7
: Let’s both just keep doing our best. We’re gonna need to if we want to compete with the raid boss that is my sister.
lines.zh: : 那我们就各自继续尽力吧。想要和我姐姐这个团队副本 boss 竞争，我们非得这么做不可。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like we must continue to leverage our chemistry in the only way that will undoubtedly appeal to our target.
lines.zh: : 听起来，我们必须继续用那种无疑能吸引目标的唯一方式，来利用我们之间的化学反应。

lines.en: : You just want to have another threesome, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你就是想再来一次三人行，对吧？

lines.en: : If it ain’t broken, don’t fix it. First one went well. Maybe we just need to take pictures of the next one and show all of {i}our{/i} followers we’re serious too?
lines.zh: : 没坏就别修。第一次挺顺利的。也许我们只需要给下一次拍几张照片，让我们所有的粉丝也看看{i}我们{/i}也是认真的？

lines.en: : I have like fifty times more followers than you, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我的粉丝大概比你的多五十倍呢，Kirin。

lines.en: : Well, I guess we know who’s making the post then.
lines.zh: : 那我想，我们知道该由谁来发帖了。

lines.en: scene black
: Oh, Nee-chan...you’ve really done it now. There’s no coming back from this.
lines.zh: : 哦，姐姐……你这下可真是干得漂亮。再也回不了头了。

lines.en: : Only a matter of time until everyone and their mom finds out. How do you think the others are taking it?
lines.zh: : 迟早所有人都会知道，连他们妈妈都会。你觉得其他人会怎么想？

lines.en: : Much worse than we are, probably...
lines.zh: : 大概比我们难受多了……

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta8
: Oh my God, Yuri. Have you looked at Insta today? The drama is {i}unreal{/i} this time.
lines.zh: : 哦我的天，Yuri。你今天看 Insta 了吗？这次的瓜也太{i}离谱{/i}了。

lines.en: : What, you mean the Niki thing? Talk about an implosion. Like, wasn’t she supposed to go on tour soon?
lines.zh: : 什么，你是说 Niki 那件事？简直是自爆。她不是很快就要开巡演了吗？

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta9
: Well, she’s definitely not anymore. They’re already in damage-control mode. But the picture is {i}still{/i} up, that’s the craziest part.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那肯定是开不成了。他们已经在紧急公关了。可最离谱的是，那张照片{i}还{/i}挂在上面。

lines.en: : I figured her producers would have, like, logged into her account and deleted it by now. You don’t think she manages her Insta herself, do you?
lines.zh: : 我还以为她的制作人早就该登进她账号把它删了呢。你该不会觉得她的 Insta 是她自己管的吧？

lines.en: : Did you read the caption? She totally does. Maybe she’s like, {i}trying{/i} to blow up for some reason?
lines.zh: : 你看了配文没有？绝对是她自己管的。也许她是想，嗯，{i}故意{/i}搞点大新闻？

lines.en: : Like a viral marketing thing? Start some controversy to get more people hyped for the tour?
lines.zh: : 像病毒营销那种？制造点争议，好让更多人期待巡演？

lines.en: : No, like trying to {i}quit{/i} and cause some commotion on the way out. There was a whole goodbye message and everything.
lines.zh: : 不是，像是想{i}退出{/i}，然后在走的时候闹点动静。还有一整段告别留言什么的。

lines.en: : Jesus. I feel like it’d be easier to come back after, like...accidentally posting nudes or something.
lines.zh: : 天哪。我觉得……比如不小心把裸照发出去之类的，之后反而更容易翻身。

lines.en: : Tiffany, we all know that you did that on purpose. Stop trying to pretend it was an accident.
lines.zh: : Tiffany，我们都知道你是故意的。别再装成是不小心的了。

lines.en: scene black
: It {i}was{/i} an accident! At least I didn’t post a goodbye message!
lines.zh: : 那{i}真的{/i}是不小心！至少我没发什么告别留言！

lines.en: : No, just a close-up of your fucking vagina. Niki would never.
lines.zh: : 是没发，就发了一张你他妈的阴部特写。Niki 绝对干不出来。

lines.en: : Ugh...I kind of wish she {i}would,{/i} though. Think there’s any chance she pivots to porn?
lines.zh: : 唉……可我有点希望她{i}会{/i}呢。你觉得她有可能转行去拍片吗？

lines.en: : Low key, she might have to if she ever wants to work in entertainment again. Just think of how much money she’d make.
lines.zh: : 说真的，如果她还想在这个圈子里混下去，可能真得走这一步。想想她能赚多少钱吧。

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta10
: God fucking damn it, Maya. You told yourself you’d stop stalking her on social media and {i}look{/i} at you now. You’re pathetic.
lines.zh: : 他妈的，Maya。你跟自己说过别再在社交媒体上跟踪她了，{i}看看{/i}你现在。你可真可悲。

lines.en: : I hope it’s a suicide note. If it’s that, I think I’ll be able to find it in myself to forgive this backtracking and-
lines.zh: : 我希望那是一封遗书。如果是的话，我想我能说服自己原谅这种出尔反尔，然后——

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta11
: In love...
lines.zh: : 恋爱了……

lines.en: : With my childhood friend?...
lines.zh: : 和我的青梅竹马？……

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta12
: What is this?...
lines.zh: : 这是什么？……

lines.en: scene black
: What about me?...
lines.zh: : 那我呢？……

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta13
: Gosh. Chinami is so thankful that the hot water actually works here. But she can’t help but feel bad for big sis Yumi who still has to take cold showers in the old apartment.
lines.zh: : 天哪。Chinami 真庆幸这里的热水还能用。不过她忍不住替 Yumi 姐姐难过，她还得在旧公寓里洗冷水澡。

lines.en: : Is dinner almost ready?
lines.zh: : 晚饭快好了吗？

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta14
: Chinami won’t ask for peanuts again, but if big sis Chika could make Chinami some kind of fancy pasta, it would make her very-
lines.zh: : Chinami 不会再要花生了，不过如果 Chika 姐姐能给 Chinami 做点高级意面什么的，她会非常——

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta15
: Big sis Chika?...
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐？……

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta16
: Is something wrong?...
lines.zh: : 有什么不对劲吗？……

lines.en: : Ch....Chinami doesn’t {i}need{/i} fancy pasta if we don’t have the money for it! She just felt like being high maintenance today!
lines.zh: : Ch……Chinami 不{i}需要{/i}高级意面，如果我们没那个钱的话！她今天只是想矫情一下而已！

lines.en: : The...bath is still hot if you want a turn! Chinami didn’t drain it...
lines.zh: : 那个……浴缸里的水还是热的，如果你想泡的话！Chinami 没有把它放掉……
: Ch……

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta17
: Chinami is interested in sex now!
lines.zh: : Chinami 现在对性感兴趣了！

lines.en: : She longs to feel the touch of a man!
lines.zh: : 她渴望感受男人的触碰！

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta18
: WHAT THE HECK HAPPENED TO MY SISTER THIS TIME?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 我姐姐这次到底是怎么了？！？！？！

lines.en: scene postnikiinsta19
: Oh, Ami. Good. There’s something I need to talk to you about. I-
lines.zh: : 哦，Ami。正好。我有件事得跟你谈谈。我——

lines.en: : How’d you do it?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么做到的？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : How did you manage to come back from fucking your childhood friend’s little sister right in front of her to {i}trending{/i} without {i}any{/i} hassle at all? Isn’t Niki supposed to hate you now?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么在当着你青梅竹马的面把她妹妹给肏了之后，还{i}一点{/i}麻烦都没有就重新爬上{i}热搜{/i}的？Niki 现在不是应该恨死你了吗？

lines.en: : Okay. Well, I guess that explains all of the looks I was getting on the way home.
lines.zh: : 好吧。嗯，我想这解释了回家路上那些目光是怎么回事。

lines.en: : Seriously, though. How? Is she really that fucking dumb? And don’t answer that, because she clearly {i}is{/i} that fucking dumb if she’s going to just post pictures of you guys together online.
lines.zh: : 说真的。怎么做到的？她真的有那么他妈的蠢吗？算了别回答，她显然{i}就是{/i}那么蠢——居然会直接把你俩的合照发到网上。

lines.en: : What if people find out where we live now, Dad? What if they come here and break in and rape me and kill me all because you decided to take some stupid selfie?
lines.zh: : 万一有人查到我们现在住哪儿呢，爸爸？万一他们跑来破门而入，强奸我、杀了我，就因为你决定拍一张愚蠢的自拍？

lines.en: : Would that make you happy? Because I think that would make you happy. If I was raped and killed. You want somebody to rape me and kill me. That’s what this is about, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那样你会开心吗？因为我觉得那会让你开心。要是我被强奸、被杀掉。你想要有人来强奸我、杀了我。说到底就是这么回事，不是吗？

lines.en: : Can you stop being ridiculous for a second and talk to me without any of the insanity I’ve come to associate with you on a terrifyingly regular basis?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别再胡闹一秒钟，好好跟我说话，别带上那些我已经恐惧地习惯了的疯癫？

lines.en: : No, but I can try.
lines.zh: : 不能，不过我可以试试。

lines.en: : I want her back. I want her {i}here.{/i} And even if it upsets you, I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 我想要她回来。我想要她在{i}这里{/i}。就算这让你不高兴，我也不在乎。

lines.en: : And how does {i}she{/i} feel about the prospect of you continuing to fuck little girls in the same bed you two use to go to sleep together? Because we both know you’re not going to just {i}stop.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那{i}她{/i}怎么想？你还要继续在那张你俩一起睡的床上肏小女孩，她对此怎么看？因为我们俩都清楚，你是不会{i}停手{/i}的。

lines.en: : Bad, obviously. But she’s broken enough to stay with me regardless, and I am going to leverage that in order to get what I want. Which is her.
lines.zh: : 当然很糟。可她已经破碎到无论如何都会留在我身边了，而我要利用这一点去得到我想要的东西。也就是她。

lines.en: : Interesting. So you’ve decided to lean further into the atrocities you habitually commit then? No more pretending to be a good guy who doesn’t want to hurt anybody?
lines.zh: : 有意思。所以你决定在你习惯性犯下的那些暴行上再进一步了？不再假装自己是个不想伤害任何人的好人了？

lines.en: : It’s not that complex, really. I’m just willing to do whatever it takes for love in hope that I’m able to actually understand it some day.
lines.zh: : 其实没那么复杂。我只是愿意为了爱不择手段，只希望有朝一日能真正理解它。

lines.en: : So what you’re saying is that all of the years I have spent trying to show you exactly what love is just haven’t worked at all and that you need {i}Niki{/i} here to really {i}get{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，我花了这么多年努力向你展示爱究竟是什么，结果一点用都没有，你需要 {i}Niki{/i} 在这里才能真正搞{i}懂{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s right. And if you have a problem with that, you can leave.
lines.zh: : 没错。如果你对此有意见，你可以走。

lines.en: : I’m going to tell her you fuck me.
lines.zh: : 我要去告诉她你肏了我。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: You’re going to lie to her?
lines.zh: : 你要对她撒谎？

lines.en: : That’s right. She has no reason to believe you instead of me. Not when you’ve {i}already{/i} lied to her.
lines.zh: : 没错。她没有理由相信你而不相信我。尤其在你{i}已经{/i}对她撒过谎的情况下。

lines.en: : Plus, I imagine it’ll be a little harder for you to come back from sexually abusing your daughter her whole life to the point where she’s now obsessed with you and thinks incest is good.

lines.en: : Do you think time is running out for some reason? Why?
lines.zh: : 你觉得时间因为某种原因快不够了吗？为什么？

lines.zh: : 我不确定。可如果时间{i}真的{/i}快不够了，你觉得你会知道吗？

lines.en: : Do you think you’d {i}want{/i} to know if I know? Or would {i}me{/i} knowing help {i}you{/i} know just how much you {i}don’t{/i} know?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你会{i}想{/i}知道我是否知道吗？还是说，{i}我{/i}知道这件事，能帮{i}你{/i}弄明白你到底有多{i}无知{/i}？

lines.en: : I don’t know.

lines.en: : You’re going to regret this, Dad. You’re about to make an innocent girl’s life complete and utter Hell because you {i}miss{/i} her. What happened to wanting her to be her best self?
lines.zh: : 你会后悔的，爸爸。你就要让一个无辜女孩的人生变成彻头彻尾的地狱，只因为你{i}想{/i}她。你那句希望她成为最好的自己，到哪儿去了？
